claim: Atom endpoint signature does not imply base-ID-only encoding.
rationale: The Atom Declaration identifies instances by (Header.ID, Header.Version).
R3011 constrains Target to an exact predecessor Version in prose.
The endpoint kind remains Atom. R2709 and D657 define ID@Version serialization for REPLACEMENT_FOR only.
No new Atom Version kind or CFEL syntax is introduced.
reviewer_disposition: No CFEL source makes [<Atom>] an unversioned base identity. Endpoint kind and storage encoding are distinct; no remaining concern.
